Episodes 1 to 14 of 18 are authored: 1289 entities, 5,944 exact mentions in original-en and 5,982 in modern-en, 1287 of the 1289 bound in the older edition and 1284 in the modern one, 157 focused tests passing, content revision 2026-09-16.14. NEXT: episode 15 (Circe, 1,441 paragraphs), night-town. 2,394 paragraphs remain and episode 15 is more than half of them; episode 17 (Ithaca) is 654 and episode 18 (Penelope) is eight paragraphs of monologue that will be the densest in the book.

EPISODE 14 IS THE FIRST EPISODE WHERE ALMOST NONE OF THE NEW CARDS IS A NEW MAN. Joyce marches the same eight men through the history of English prose and renames them in every pastiche: sir Leopold and young Stephen in the Malory, Leop. Bloom and Stephen D. in the Pepys, Mr Canvasser Bloom and Mr Coadjutor Deacon Dedalus in the parliamentary report, Mr L. Bloom (Pubb. Canv.) and Mr S. Dedalus (Div. Scep.) in the scientific one, and Mr Cautious Calmer and Young Boasthard in the Bunyan. THE WORK WAS NOT FINDING PEOPLE, IT WAS DECIDING WHICH DISGUISE IS A CARD AND WHICH IS A COSTUME. The rule applied: a name Joyce writes as a NAME gets a card (Le Fecondateur, Glory Allelujurum, Young Boasthard); a pastiche title that is only an office (Mr Canvasser Bloom, Mr Delegate Madden) is bound to the man.

THE SEVEN BUNYAN MASKS AT 14:28, AND THE ONE THE TEXT REFUSES. Six are fixed by sentences within two paragraphs of the list: YOUNG BOASTHARD is Stephen (he that had erst challenged to be so doughty waxed wan, 14:26), MR CAUTIOUS CALMER is Bloom (Master Bloom spoke to him calming words, 14:26), MR SOMETIMES GODLY is Madden (Master Madden, being godly certain whiles, 14:26), MR APE SWILLALE is Costello (like a curse of God ape, 14:22, and fell hard again to his yale), MR FALSE FRANKLIN is Lenehan (the franklin that hight Lenehan, four times), MR DAINTY DIXON is Dixon. MR CAVIL IS LEFT UNATTACHED: Crotthers is the one man the list does not otherwise account for and Lynch is the one who were in doubt that the world was right evil governed, and the episode does not choose. He has a card that says so and no man is bound to it. DO NOT RESOLVE HIM FROM SCHOLARSHIP; RESOLVE HIM FROM THE TEXT OR LEAVE HIM.

FOUR NAMESAKE TRAPS THAT WOULD HAVE SHIPPED. LYNCH is Lynch's castle at 12:417 and the mob's verb Lynch him! at 15:501. MADDEN is O'Madden Burke eighteen times, Mr Justice Madden at 9:237 and O. Madden the jockey at 7:193, 10:234 and 14:45 -- and 14:59 (Madden back Madden's a maddening back) DOES NOT SETTLE WHICH AND IS UNBOUND. VINCENT is Vincent O'Brien at 15:547, a solicitors' firm at 12:59 and S. Vincent at 12:513. LEOPOLD AT 14:48 IS AN EMBRYOLOGIST, not Bloom, standing between Hertwig and Valenti. Also keyed: Lusk (a village at 12:26), Mina (Mina Kennedy nine times in episode 11), Charley (M'Coy and Charley MacDowell), Mamy (Mamy Dillon at 18:7), Joan (Shakespeare's sister), Calmer (an adjective at 11:442), Pious (Pious fraud at 5:101), Preservative (Potato Preservative at 15:546) and Phenomenon (12:172).

BASS IS TWO THINGS IN TWO ADJACENT PARAGRAPHS. Bass's mare at 14:45 is MR W. BASS who owns Sceptre; number one Bass bottled by Messrs Bass and Co at 14:46 is the ale. The owner is keyed and the ale carries no card. The same key resolves Bass's mare at 12:347, WHICH HAD BEEN LEFT UNBOUND IN EPISODE 12. Mr W. Bass is named in full at 16:226 and should be keyed when episode 16 is read.

THE EXTEND-DON'T-DUPLICATE RULE CAUGHT A DUPLICATE CARD AGAIN, AND THE DEAD-ALIAS SWEEP IS WHAT FOUND IT. A doctor-ohare card was written for episode 14 before the sweep showed that episode 13 already had one; the alias 'Doctor O'Hare' matched NOTHING because Joyce writes O'HARE DOCTOR. One card now, extended: episode 13 has Bloom remember nurse Callan brushing his coat, episode 14 says he is dead in Mona Island. The same rule extended medical Dick and medical Davy (their lowercase mentions at 9:344 had been unbound since episode 9), Dixon, Lenehan, nurse Callan, Dr Horne, Childs, M'Intosh, and HAMLET, whose card said 'the play' and now says plainly that it carries the prince too, which is how episode 9 had been using it all along.

THE MODERN EDITION OF EPISODE 14 CHANGES NO NAME AND ADDS NO GLOSS -- the first clean episode since 10, after Henry Flower (Bloom's pen name) in 11, the Citizen (the nationalist) seventy times in 12 and Howth (the headland) four times in 13. THE GLOSS HABIT MUST STILL BE CHECKED IN 15 TO 18. What this episode's edition does instead is unwind the archaism: thou/thy/thee to you/your fifty-six times of a hundred and forty-one edits over thirty-seven paragraphs. One rendering loses the sense and is recorded as a source defect: 'in twelve moons thrice an hundred' (three hundred deliveries in a year) becomes 'three hundred months'. No edition byte was touched. THIS LANE NEVER SETS appStatus.

EPISODE 15: THE ITALIC SWEEP HAS ALREADY BEEN RUN AHEAD OF READING, AND THE NEWS IS BETTER THAN FEARED. Circe is 1,441 paragraphs and 230,035 characters -- twice episode 14 -- with 2,510 underscores, about 1,255 italic spans. But the trap only bites where a name sits flush against an underscore, and uitalic.py 15 15 finds exactly TWO: STEPHEN at 15:1133 (_Stephen throws his ashplant on the table_) and TOM ROCHFORD at 15:361 (_Tom Rochford, robinredbreasted_). Both need keys or phrases when Circe is authored. Re-run the sweep after every batch of new aliases, because the trap is a property of the alias, not of the paragraph, and an underscore satisfies \w, so an alias inside _like this_ binds nothing and nothing reports it. ALSO WAITING IN UNREAD TERRITORY: Patrice at 16:212 is THE FAUBOURG SAINT PATRICE, not Patrice Egan, and needs suppressing. The nine medical students walk past in a body at 15:619 and Punch Costello returns as a hobgoblin at 15:601, so Lynch and Madden both need keys there. EPISODE 15 HAS ALREADY BEEN READ IN FULL AND SWEPT, AND FOUR THINGS ARE SETTLED BEFORE A CARD IS WRITTEN. (1) THE PRE-AUTHORING SWEEP IS CLEAN: 146 distinct name-to-card pairs already bind in Circe and 145 are right. The one to finish is 15:1340, where Haines binds alone inside THE REVEREND MR HUGH C HAINES LOVE M. A. -- Joyce has fused Haines of the tower with the reverend Hugh C. Love of Wandering Rocks, and hugh-c-love ALREADY HAS A CARD, so bind both halves by the Siopold idiom. (2) LIPOTI VIRAG IN CIRCE IS BLOOMS GRANDFATHER, NOT HIS FATHER. Bloom calls Rudolph papachi at 15:77 and Virag GRANPAPACHI at 15:637. The Virag SPLIT table is keyed to rudolph-bloom from episode 12; Circe needs a NEW card and its own keys. Merging them would fuse two generations. (3) THE MODERN EDITION OF EPISODE 15 CHANGES ONE SPEAKER LABEL: THE VIRAGO: at 15:12 and 15:1289 becomes the fierce woman: -- lowercased, breaking the episodes own convention that every speaker is in capitals. Kithogue! at 15:4 becomes lefty!. Nothing else in 52 changed paragraphs touches a name. (4) THE SCALE: 1,441 paragraphs, 269 distinct speaker labels over 1,115 speech lines, 1,215 distinct mid-sentence capitalised tokens of which 865 are in no card name or alias yet. AUTHOR IT IN BLOCKS BY SCENE -- the street, the trial, the coronation, the brothel, Bello, the nymph, the dance and the mother, the street fight, Corny Kelleher -- and build after each block. Objects speak in this episode (THE SOAP, THE FAN, THE HOOF, THE PIANOLA, THE YEWS, BLACK LIZ): decide whether they are cast BEFORE authoring and say so in the README, because the episode-12 rule (men and women are cast, things are not) has never had to deal with a thing that talks.

THE BUILD TAKES ABOUT FOURTEEN MINUTES OF CPU AND THE TEST RUN ANOTHER TWELVE, BUT THE TEST RUN DOES NOT HAVE TO BE PAID TWICE. WHEN ONLY TEST EXPECTATIONS OR CARD BODIES CHANGE, DRY-RUN THE SUITE AGAINST THE PACKAGE THAT IS ALREADY BUILT instead of recompiling: stub build_ulysses.compile_package to return (characters.v1.json, validation-report.json, None), copy SPLIT/PHRASE/SUPPRESS/bind off the real module for the Tables class, put the stub in sys.modules and load test_ulysses. The whole suite then runs in THIRTEEN SECONDS. It caught the last two stale expectations in episode 14 (hamlet at 14:23 and the unittest-elided second thin card, mahound) without a twenty-six minute round trip. Only a change that moves a BINDING needs the real build. Run it in the background and wait on the log; do not poll.
